roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines two critical functions, ensuring both the continuous professional growth of our nursing staff and the highest standards of infection prevention and control within our facility.You will be instrumental in developing and implementing educational programs for staff, fostering a culture of continuous learning and competency. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control efforts, conducting surveillance, developing policies, and educating staff to maintain a safe and healthy environment for our residents and team members.This is an excellent opportunity for an RN passionate about education and patient safety to make a significant impact in a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development, education, or training
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and standards
